title: MSFS 2024 Marketplace: FSR500, Do 228 & 737 MAX Warning!
description:
This week’s MSFS 2024 Marketplace update brings the native FSReborn FSR500, Carenado Dornier Do 228-200, Halo D77-TC Pelican, and a buyer-beware look at the RM Studios 737 MAX 6.

From rugged STOL regional operations and MSFS 2024 VIP Charter career flights to high-altitude turboprop cruising and orbital dropships, here is a full breakdown of what landed in the Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 Marketplace—and which add-ons are actually worth buying, renting, or gifting. We examine the Carenado Do 228-200 with its twin TPE331 turboprops and hybrid BendixKing/Garmin/Collins avionics, check out FSReborn’s deeply simulated FSR500 (complete with CFD flight dynamics, custom icing, passenger behavior, and EFB tablet), take a skeptical look at the budget RM Studios Boeing 737 MAX 6, and revisit the Misriah Armory D77-TC Pelican from Halo.
